t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep going for one coloured basket until it gives 0 points, move to the other basket until it gives 0 and so on and so forth.

vb_textbox.text: The thing I did was to move left to right until I received 0 points then almost restarted. For example - L R L R,  then I got 0 so I went R, L, R, L.
